title: He died in a sweltering house. Why doesn't his death record show it?
description: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

de: Er starb in einem schwülen Haus. Warum zeigt seine Sterbeurkunde das nicht? Wenn Arizona hitzebedingte Todesfälle zählt, ist Adam Willson nicht enthalten. Seine Geschichte zeigt, wie in den Vereinigten Staaten jedes Jahr Tausende von Hitzetoten ungezählt bleiben können.
en: He died in a sweltering house. Why doesn't his death record show it?. When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.
la: Mortuus est in tabernis aedibus. Cur mors eius non indicat? Cum Arizona mortes calores relatas numerat, Adam Willson inclusus non est. Narratio eius ostendit quomodo milia caloris mortes quotannis in Civitatibus Foederatis numerari possunt.
